tasks.prompt: Draw an architecture diagram of an online shop: web app, API, database, job queue and an external payment gateway. About 10 nodes.
Draw an architecture diagram of a monorepo with three nested groups (apps, services, data), about 20 nodes, and a `source` path on four of them.
Draw a workflow diagram of expense approval with a manager and a finance lane, one decision and a rejection path.
Draw a workflow diagram of employee onboarding with a retry loop when a check fails and a wait step for documents.
Draw an ERD of a blog: users, posts, comments, tags and post_tags; comments can reply to other comments (self-reference).
Draw an ERD of a payments schema with 8 tables, optional columns and several single-column foreign keys into the same table.
Draw a sequence diagram of logging in with OAuth: browser, app and identity provider, with an `alt` for denied consent.
Draw a sequence diagram of a checkout where the app retries a payment call in a `loop`, with a note over the payment provider.
